instruction: Reduce your favorites dock to contain exactly one application: Vim.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires removing Thunderbird and Chrome, keeping only Vim in favorites. Uses existing check_gnome_favorite_apps metric to verify only one app remains.
